title: Mark the staircase
introduction: Recognise a repeating route and express it as one repeated block.
explanation: A for loop repeats its body a fixed number of times. Here, one unit is a whole stair: east, mark, left, north, mark, right. Karel is facing east again before the next repetition.
objective: Climb all four stairs. Put exactly one coin on every square you enter. Leave the starting square empty. Finish at (5, 5), facing east, with an empty bag.
instruction: Use a for loop with four repetitions. The supplied turnRight() function is the one you built in the previous lesson.

commands.description: Run the entire block four times. The counter is only used by this fixed-repeat form.

hints: Find the shortest block that both climbs one stair and restores the starting direction.
Each stair needs two moves, two putBeeper() calls and two turns.
Inside the loop: move and mark, turn left, move and mark, then turn right.

illustration.alt: One stair unit: move east and mark, then move north and mark. Repeat this unit four times, restoring the eastward heading after each stair.
illustration.caption: One stair unit: move east and mark, then move north and mark. Repeat this unit four times, restoring the eastward heading after each stair.
